name: Transparent Heuristic Narrative Risk Method
description: A weighted, inspectable review heuristic with traceable evidence, narrative mapping, governed review, monitoring, stakeholder and comparative analysis, publication controls, and explicit production-hardening policy. Hardening reports remain advisory and do not replace operator security, privacy, accessibility, or recovery obligations.

source_type.label: Source type
source_type.rationale: Less direct or less accountable source types increase the need for corroboration.
source_type.remediation: Prefer primary, audited, or independently verifiable sources and preserve links.

evidence_strength.label: Evidence strength
evidence_strength.rationale: Claims supported by limited, unclear, or weak evidence carry greater interpretation risk.
evidence_strength.remediation: Narrow the claim, add stronger evidence, or state the evidentiary limitation explicitly.

uncertainty.label: Uncertainty
uncertainty.rationale: Unresolved assumptions and unknowns increase the chance that confidence exceeds support.
uncertainty.remediation: Separate knowns, assumptions, and unknowns and state confidence limits.

narrative_volatility.label: Narrative volatility
narrative_volatility.rationale: Fast-changing narratives can make otherwise credible evidence stale or incomplete.
narrative_volatility.remediation: Timestamp the assessment and re-check material changes before reuse.

stakeholder_pressure.label: Stakeholder pressure
stakeholder_pressure.rationale: Strong incentives or reputational pressure may shape framing, omission, or interpretation.
stakeholder_pressure.remediation: Document relevant incentives, conflicts, and alternative interpretations.

time_sensitivity.label: Time sensitivity
time_sensitivity.rationale: Time-sensitive claims require fresher evidence and a shorter review horizon.
time_sensitivity.remediation: Confirm source freshness and assign a reassessment date.

consequences.label: Consequences
consequences.rationale: Greater potential harm from overstatement warrants stricter review even when evidence appears adequate.
consequences.remediation: Escalate to the appropriate domain, legal, compliance, or editorial reviewer.

review_status.label: Review completion
review_status.rationale: Incomplete review leaves assumptions, source quality, and intended use insufficiently tested.
review_status.remediation: Record a reviewer, review date, disposition, and any conditions before approval.

source_count.label: Source count
source_count.rationale: A claim supported by few sources is more vulnerable to duplication, error, and untested framing.
source_count.remediation: Add independent corroboration or explain why a single authoritative source is sufficient.

decision_notes.Low: Risk appears lower by heuristic review, but source links and review date should still be preserved.
decision_notes.Medium: Use cautiously with visible uncertainty, source links, and review notes.
decision_notes.High: Do not use as a confident public claim without additional review, source support, and narrowed language.

flag_rules.text: Evidence does not yet support confident use
High uncertainty should be stated explicitly
Stakeholder pressure may be influencing interpretation
Time-sensitive claim requires recent source check

action_rules.text: Add at least one independent source or primary reference.
Rewrite claim with narrower language until evidence improves.
Add an uncertainty note that separates knowns, assumptions, and unknowns.
Re-check source freshness before publication or decision use.
Document whether pressure, incentives, or reputational concerns may be shaping the claim.
Escalate to domain, legal, compliance, or editorial review as appropriate.
Record a reviewer, date, and decision before treating the claim as approved.
Maintain source links, method notes, and review date for future audit.

human_decision_boundary: Heuristic interpretation is advisory. A human disposition is stored separately and is never inferred from the score.

ledger_policy.source_type_derivation: Select the lowest-risk source type among sources linked by support or qualification; if none exist, inspect all linked sources; if none are linked, use unknown.
ledger_policy.source_count_derivation: Count unique sources connected to the primary claim through evidence relationships.
ledger_policy.evidence_strength_derivation: Start with the strongest positive evidence relationship, downgrade one level when fewer than two independent source groups support the primary claim, and downgrade one additional level when contradictory evidence is present.

flags.no_relationships: No evidence relationship has been recorded for the primary claim
flags.contested: The evidence ledger contains contradictory evidence for the primary claim
flags.dependent_sources: Source duplication or dependency reduces independent corroboration
flags.stale_sources: One or more linked sources are marked stale
flags.indirect_only: The primary claim is supported only by indirect or unknown-directness sources

actions.record_relationships: Link each material claim to specific evidence excerpts and sources.
actions.resolve_contestation: Document how contradictory evidence changes wording, confidence, or intended use.
actions.add_independent_sources: Add independently produced corroboration or disclose source dependency.
actions.refresh_stale_sources: Refresh stale sources before publication or decision use.
actions.add_direct_evidence: Add direct evidence or explain why indirect evidence is sufficient.

narrative_map_interpretation.boundary: Narrative diagnostics identify structural review needs; they do not determine truth, intent, or approval.
narrative_map_interpretation.high_severity_action: Resolve high-severity map issues before confident public use.

governance_policy.boundary: Heuristic scores and narrative diagnostics are advisory. Only authorized human reviewers may create governance decisions.
governance_policy.expiration_behavior: An approved workflow becomes expired after valid_until and requires a new revision or reassessment decision before publication.
governance_policy.reassessment_behavior: A reassessment_at date creates a due item even when valid_until has not elapsed.

monitoring_policy.boundary: Monitoring detects change, freshness, and reassessment needs; it does not verify truth, alter the analytical score, or approve publication.

stakeholder_policy.boundary: Stakeholder intelligence documents observable actors, relationships, incentives, pressures, disclosures, and consequences. It does not infer undisclosed motives, certify conflicts, or silently change the analytical score.
stakeholder_policy.canvas_handoff_mode: Explicit import; preserve Canvas identifiers and source provenance.

comparative_policy.boundary: Comparative analysis evaluates explicit records, frames, assumptions, and scenarios. It does not certify truth, infer an optimal narrative, or silently change canonical analytical scores.
comparative_policy.decision_studio_handoff_mode: Explicit, checksummed handoff with selected scenarios, evidence matrix, sensitivity results, portfolio summary, and governance context.

hardening_policy.boundary: Production-readiness reports evaluate declared controls and local artifacts. They do not certify security, privacy compliance, accessibility conformance, disaster recovery, or legal sufficiency.
